description: 本地 vs 云端模型问数对比评测集：从 148 条主集按类别配额确定性抽样 60 条（single_agg 14 / join 10 / time 11 / subquery 9 / clarify 6 / refuse 6 / permission 4，类内均匀间隔抽取，非随机可复现）。两个引擎使用完全相同的用例，经 npm run eval -- --file server/eval/evalCases.compare60.json --engine <e> --model <m> 运行。

categories.time: 时间对比（按 LEFT(date,7) 年月分组/环比/区间对比）
categories.subquery: 嵌套子查询（IN/NOT IN/EXISTS/标量/派生表）
categories.clarify: 需澄清（问题歧义，模型应澄清而非猜测）
categories.refuse: 应拒答（不存在表/敏感字段/写操作/超出数据源范围）
categories.permission: 行级权限（受限数据源，行过滤谓词注入后结果与 golden 等价）

cases.question: 一共有多少个客户？
cases.goldenSql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS c FROM clients

cases.question: 各区域的客户数量是多少？
cases.goldenSql: SELECT region, COUNT(*) AS c FROM clients GROUP BY region

cases.question: 重点客户有多少个？
cases.goldenSql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS c FROM clients WHERE isKeyAccount = 1

cases.question: 一共有多少条拜访记录？
cases.goldenSql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS c FROM visits

cases.question: 线下拜访有多少次？
cases.goldenSql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS c FROM visits WHERE type = '线下拜访'

cases.question: 积极情感的拜访有多少条？
cases.goldenSql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS c FROM visits WHERE sentiment = '积极'

cases.question: 线上会议有多少次？
cases.goldenSql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS c FROM visits WHERE type = '线上会议'

cases.question: 启用状态的用户有多少个？

cases.question: 一共有多少个角色？

cases.question: 央国企客户有多少个？

cases.question: 客户数超过10个的行业有哪些？

cases.question: 每个客户的拜访次数分别是多少？
cases.goldenSql: SELECT c.name, COUNT(v.id) AS c FROM clients c JOIN visits v ON v.clientId = c.id GROUP BY c.name

cases.question: 各行业的拜访次数是多少？
cases.goldenSql: SELECT c.industry, COUNT(v.id) AS c FROM clients c JOIN visits v ON v.clientId = c.id GROUP BY c.industry

cases.question: 各用户负责的客户数是多少？

cases.question: 各角色的用户数是多少？
cases.goldenSql: SELECT r.name, COUNT(u.id) AS c FROM roles r JOIN users u ON u.roleId = r.id GROUP BY r.name

cases.question: 积极情感拜访涉及多少个客户？
cases.goldenSql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT v.clientId) AS c FROM visits v JOIN clients c ON v.clientId = c.id WHERE v.sentiment = '积极'

cases.question: 央国企客户的拜访次数是多少？
cases.goldenSql: SELECT COUNT(v.id) AS c FROM visits v JOIN clients c ON v.clientId = c.id WHERE c.listCategory = '央国企客户'

cases.question: 没有拜访记录的客户有多少个？

cases.question: 各团队客户的拜访次数是多少？

cases.question: 拜访次数高于月均水平的月份有哪些？
cases.goldenSql: SELECT LEFT(`date`, 7) AS ym FROM visits GROUP BY LEFT(`date`, 7) HAVING COUNT(*) > (SELECT COUNT(*) / COUNT(DISTINCT LEFT(`date`, 7)) FROM visits)
